title: Aira 3.8.3 update
summary: This release moves the app recommendation into Settings and realigns the Home favorites grid.
items: The app recommendation no longer pops up on Home. It now lives in Settings → App recommendations, where opening an app shows its introduction, reviews and questions, with a link to view it in AppGallery.
A fresh install's Home page no longer preloads default shortcuts: the favorites grid starts empty for you to fill, and favorites you already have are untouched.
Fixed the Home favorites grid drifting into the middle when it holds few items; the icons now start from the leading edge.
